statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk sits in the low band on contained two-sided overnight structure, while Stress stays high on a 24-year-high long-end yield backdrop.
recommendation: Tail remains below the watch threshold on contained, two-sided overnight NQ structure. The identified danger window spans 12:15Z to 15:30Z, covering the August PCE report and Q2 GDP third estimate at 12:30Z, the 13:30Z US cash open and the 13:45Z Chicago PMI, with a secondary flow concentration at the 20:00Z quarter-end closing auction.
headline: Contained two-sided overnight NQ rotation keeps Tail low; 24-year-high long yields keep Stress high into the quarter-end PCE and GDP cluster
body: NQ futures trade near 30,590-30,597, roughly 0.05-0.08% lower, inside a contained overnight band of about 30,571-30,737. Price opened near 30,657, reached 30,737 and has rotated back toward the lower half of that 0.54%-wide band, so retracement has been available in both directions and there is no observed signature of shallow-or-absent pullbacks, repeated extension after failed retracements, or NQ holding near a session extreme. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed September 29 at 30,339.33, up 0.21%, after a narrow 30,235.67-30,429.97 range, and the 52-week high at 30,770.63 has not been challenged overnight. E-mini S&P 500 futures are firmer near 7,744, about 0.16% higher, so the two US index futures are not aligned in one direction. VIX sits near 16.04, little changed. Asian trade was mixed to firm, with the Nikkei up around 1-2%, the Hang Seng essentially flat, the KOSPI marginally lower and the Shanghai Composite slightly higher. On this evidence Tail stays in the low band at 16 and the mapped policy state is EA_ON. The Stress backdrop is genuinely difficult. The 30-year Treasury yield reached 5.61-5.62% on September 29, its highest since 2002 and a sixth consecutive daily advance, and the 10-year printed 5.28-5.29%. The Federal Reserve H.15 release for September 28 shows the 2-year at 4.92%, the 10-year at 5.24% and the 30-year at 5.56%. Cited drivers include elevated oil, heavy corporate issuance and an unwinding yen carry trade; CME fed funds futures price roughly even odds for the October 28 meeting and skew toward a higher range by December 9, while the New York Fed president said there is no urgency to raise rates again. Conference Board consumer confidence fell to 81.9 from 88.6 against an expectation near 89, a 12-year low, with 68.4% of respondents anticipating higher rates, and August JOLTS openings came in near 7.08-7.10 million below a 7.23 million expectation. Breadth is narrow: semiconductor funds have outperformed strongly over the past 20 sessions while the equal-weighted S&P 500 has fallen, and Nvidia authorised a $150 billion buyback. Oil has eased from its highs, with WTI near $89.72 and Brent near $96.50, after Saudi Arabia restarted its East-West pipeline and US and Iranian officials met with mediators, which removes rather than adds a Tail amplifier. Stress is therefore held at 65 in the high band and Confidence at 88, reflecting current futures, cash, volatility, yield, oil and calendar evidence gathered from primary and reputable sources. The shared Finviz context file was read and found stale and partial, dated 2026-09-29T23:14:22Z with calendar and futures sections unavailable, so it was excluded and independent research was used throughout.

lookbackSummary: Across the 24 hours to 04:00Z, published Claude assessments eased steadily from Tail 23 with Stress 79 early on September 29 to Tail 16 with Stress 65 in the final four slots. The September 29 US session produced a narrow Nasdaq-100 range and a modestly higher close despite the 30-year yield reaching a 24-year high, and dominant mode migrated from trend-down through mixed to normal and back to mixed as two-sided behaviour reasserted itself. One hour, 14:00Z on September 29, has no published assessment and remains explicitly unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon is shaped by one dense catalyst cluster on the final session of Q3. Conditional Tail stays in the low band through the Asian and European hours, lifts into the watch band across 12:00Z to 15:00Z as the August PCE report, the Q2 GDP third estimate, the US cash open and the September Chicago PMI overlap, then decays through the US afternoon with a small lift into the 20:00Z quarter-end closing auction before reaching its horizon low overnight. Stress follows the same arc within the high band. No slot reaches the block threshold on current evidence. The named invalidation is a post-release long-end yield extension that produces shallow pullbacks, repeated extension after failed retracements, or NQ holding near a session extreme; observing that pattern would justify a higher Tail than any slot published here.

forecast.analysis: Observed: NQ futures near 30,590-30,597, about 0.05-0.08% lower, inside a contained overnight band near 30,571-30,737 after rotating back down from the 30,737 high. Retracements are present and VIX sits near 16.04, so Tail stays in the low band while 24-year-high long yields keep Stress high.

Event importance is not counted as observed price-path alignment
WTI near $89.72 and Brent near $96.50, easing off recent highs

forecast.analysis: Liquidity usually thins through the European lunch hour before the US cluster. Conditional Tail rises modestly because a thinner book can extend a move further per unit of flow, not because directional structure has been observed in this hour.

Consensus August core PCE near 3.4% YoY versus 3.3% in July

forecast.analysis: Mid-afternoon holding hour before quarter-end flow builds. Conditional Tail is unchanged. This is carried as the quietest window of the US session unless the long end extends further and equities begin to track it one-directionally.

forecast.analysis: Power hour on the last session of the quarter. Conditional Tail lifts slightly for rebalancing flow that can run in one direction without reflecting fundamentals. Quarter to date, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq stand around 2% higher and the Dow near 2% lower.

forecast.analysis: The 20:00Z quarter-end closing auction is the largest single-print flow event of this horizon. Conditional Tail peaks for the afternoon at the top of the low band, and mode is whipsaw because auction imbalance typically reverses afterwards rather than extending.
drivers: 20:00Z quarter-end closing auction concentrates rebalancing flow
Auction imbalances typically reverse rather than extend
Mechanical flow is not treated as evidence of a regime change

forecast.analysis: Post-close hour. Conditional Tail falls as cash liquidity leaves and futures resume a thinner, typically range-bound path. Residual risk shifts toward headline sensitivity in a thin book rather than sustained directional efficiency.

A thin post-close futures book raises headline sensitivity
